Pass to a New Land'') is the 31st chapter of the {{MangaArc|Sword & Shield}} of the [[Pokémon Adventures]] manga. ==Plot== {{spoilers}} [[Oleana]] shows everyone the [[Armor Pass|Armor]] and [[Crown Pass]]es she acquired. [[Hop]] notes that the [[Isle of Armor]] is where [[Leon]] used to train and plays a video of [[Mustard]] advertising the [[Master Dojo]]. On the other hand, the [[Crown Tundra]] is a desolate place with few inhabitants; however, there have been reports of mysterious Pokémon roaming around, so its danger should not be underestimated. Oleana selects {{Casey}} and [[Marvin]] to go to the Isle of Armor, and Hop, [[Marnie]], and [[Bede]] to go to the Crown Tundra. Casey loudly proclaims that she will find Henry for sure. At the Isle of Armor, [[Klara]] and [[Avery]] are chasing down a group of {{rf|Galarian}} {{p|Slowpoke}} who have stolen their uniforms across the [[Soothing Wetlands]]. The two bicker with each other, and they reflect on their endeavors. They both want to end their training fast and become [[Gym Leader]]s. The Slowpoke return, but instead of holding the uniforms, they hold {{Henry}}'s unconscious body. Klara and Avery return to the Master Dojo and tell Mustard about the incident. Klara remembers meeting a poison expert during a tour and decides to call her. Klara calls "{{adv|Moon|Miss Poison}}" and is given instructions. Meanwhile, Casey and the others all depart and board a train at [[Wedgehurst]] to their respective locations. Back at the Master Dojo, [[Hyde]] uses the [[Cram-o-matic]] 2.0 to make Henry's medicine, and Klara gives it to him. The medicine causes Henry's hair to rapidly grow, but also expels the poison, waking him up. Mustard greets Henry and asks him if he has anyone to contact. Henry is reluctant to contact anyone because of a previous situation, so Mustard tells him that he can join the Master Dojo in the meantime. Casey and Martin arrive at the Isle of Armor and head towards the Master Dojo, but Klara stops them. She challenges them to a battle, and Casey accepts, much to Martin's chagrin. Casey accidentally sends out all six of her Pokémon, and she starts to cry. Klara believes that Casey is mocking her, and she sends out a Galarian Slowpoke in revenge. Martin notices that Klara's Slowpoke is different than normal and may be a different [[type]]. Casey orders {{p|Falinks|Giga}} to use {{m|First Impression}} and easily defeats the Slowpoke. Klara next sends out her {{p|Venipede}}, which Casey has never seen before due to it not being present in [[Galar]]. Casey sends out her {{p|Raboot}}, [[Bit]], and orders it to use {{m|Flame Charge}}, which defeats the Venipede. Klara panics and thinks that if Casey arrives at the dojo, her talent will cause people to forget about Klara. Avery, hiding behind a tree, has similar thoughts. Klara quickly runs off, and Casey runs after her. Henry hears Casey's voice, and he stands up in shock. ==Major events== * {{Casey}} and [[Marvin]] depart for the [[Isle of Armor]] while [[Hop]], [[Marnie]], and [[Bede]] depart for the [[Crown Tundra]]. * [[Klara]] and [[Avery]] find {{Henry}} and bring him to [[Mustard]]. * Klara asks {{adv|Moon}} for advice on curing Henry of {{p|Eternatus}}'s poison and makes a medicine for him. * Casey nicknames her {{p|Raboot}} [[Bit]]. {{Adventuresevents}} {{endspoilers}} ===Debuts=== ====Humans==== * [[Klara]] * [[Avery]] * [[Mustard]] * {{OBP|Honey|character}} * [[Hyde]] ====Pokémon debuts==== * {{p|Slowpoke}} ([[Galarian form|Galarian Form]]) ==Characters== ===Humans=== * {{adv|Moon}} (silhouette; flashback) * [[Henry Sword|Henry]] * [[Casey Shield|Casey]] * [[Professor Magnolia]] * [[Hop]] * [[Bede]] * [[Marnie]] * [[Avery]] * [[Klara]] * [[Mustard]] * {{OBP|Honey|character}} * [[Hyde]] * [[Sonia]] * [[Oleana]] * [[Marvin]] ===Pokémon=== * {{p|Raboot}} ([[Bit]]; {{Casey}}'s) * {{p|Falinks}} (Giga; {{Casey}}'s) * {{p|Arrokuda}} (Kilo; {{Casey}}'s) * {{p|Toxtricity}} (Tera; {{DL|List of Pokémon with form differences|Toxtricity|Low Key}}; {{Casey}}'s) * {{p|Stunfisk}} (Mega; [[Galarian form|Galarian Form]]; {{Casey}}'s) * {{p|Eiscue}} (Peta; {{DL|List of Pokémon with form differences|Eiscue|Ice Face}}; {{Casey}}'s) * {{p|Rotom}} ([[Rotom Phone]]; [[Hop]]'s) * {{p|Rotom}} ([[Rotom Phone]]; [[Klara]]'s) * {{p|Slowpoke}} ([[Galarian form|Galarian Form]]; [[Klara]]'s) * {{p|Venipede}} ([[Klara]]'s) * {{p|Slowpoke}} (×3; [[Galarian form|Galarian Form]]; [[Master Dojo]]'s) * {{p|Corviknight}} ([[Flying Taxi]]) ==Trivia== * In this round, it is revealed that [[Klara]] only sold eight copies of her album. ===Errors=== * On one page, [[Marnie]]'s name is misspelled as "Marie". {{MangaPrevNext/Adventures |prevcode=PASS30 |prevtitle=Oh My!!
